title: Management Trainee
description:
Role Objective / Major Purpose of the Job
  
  
Interpret, analyze, read, and make recommendations that improve a workforce with an eye on reducing overhead and increasing productivity and reducing employee costs. Serve as a primary point of contact for workforce management policies and are subject matter experts on workforce optimization steps. They ensure service-level targets are being met and maintain the proper headcount while calculating call capacity. Role is responsible for compiling, structuring, and analyzing human resources data to make conclusions that help streamline all processes. Key competencies include data analysis, business acumen, relationship management, HR expertise, communication, HR systems, and cultural awareness. Hands-on knowledge of SAP Success Factors would be required.
  
  
Principal Tasks & Responsibilities
  
  

* Implementation of all modules of SAP Success Factors.
* Gather benchmark data about jobs, compensation and benefits
* Map out salary ranges for our open positions
* Calculate retention, turnover and internal mobility rates
* Report on key recruiting metrics like time to fill and hiring costs
* Assist hiring managers in designing hiring and training plans
* Forecast costs by department and help create budgets
* Analyze employees’ answers to internal surveys (like job satisfaction surveys)
* Assess results from our employee performance reviews
* Identify top reasons why candidates and employees choose to work with our company and

recommend areas of improvement for our HR procedures
  
  

* Collect, clean, and analyze HR data from various sources, including HRIS (Human

Resources Information System), performance management systems, employee surveys,
  
  
and other relevant platforms.
  
  

* Utilize statistical and analytical techniques to identify trends, patterns, and correlations in HR data.
* Conduct predictive and prescriptive analytics to anticipate future HR needs and provide

strategic recommendations.
  
  

* Develop and maintain HR dashboards and reports to visualize key metrics and

performance indicators.
  
  

* Regularly provide HR leaders and stakeholders with actionable insights based on data

analysis.
  
  

* Collaborate with HR and business leaders to understand workforce dynamics and

contribute to workforce planning initiatives.
  
  

* Analyse workforce trends, including turnover, retention, and succession planning, to

support strategic talent management decisions.
  
  

* Stay updated on HR analytics trends, tools, and best practices to enhance the analytical

capabilities within the HR function.
  
  

* Propose and implement process improvements to streamline data collection and analysis.
* Manage the development of real time automated HR dashboards like Hiring, Attrition,

Diversity, Performance, Talent Management dashboards to analyse organizational trends
  
  
of employees from Hire to Retire.
  
  

* Perform workforce Analytics to understand the effect of Employee Engagement in

enhancing the productivity of the store & front-line employees
  
  

* Developed a real -time one stop shop dashboard for workforce catering to the Business

need
  
  

* Lead all the data & streamline them.

Key Skills & Competencies
  
  
**Functional / Technical**
SAP SuccessFactors
  
  
HR Analytics
  
  
HRIS Management
  
  
Compensation Benchmarking
  
  
Workforce Planning
  
  
Dashboard Reporting
  
  
Excel, SQL & Power BI
  
  
**Behavioural**
Analytical Thinking
  
  
Problem Solving
  
  
Strategic Planning
  
  
Decision Making
  
  
Communication

title: Executive
description:
Role Objective / Major Purpose of the Job
  
  
The Executive – Market Research collects, organizes and analyzes market data to support the marketing team's decisions. The role provides accurate, timely information on markets, competitors and customers for the assigned therapy area and brands. It works under the guidance of the Assistant Manager or Manager – Market Research and the Marketing Project Lead.
  
  
Principal Tasks & Responsibilities
  
  
Data Collection & Analysis
  
  
Collect and update market, sales, prescription and competitor data from secondary sources, audit data and the field.
  
  
Clean, organize and analyze data, and prepare regular MIS reports and dashboards.
  
  
Market Intelligence
  
  
Monitor competitor activities, launches, pricing and promotions, and report them on time.
  
  
Track market and therapy trends and prepare summaries for the marketing team.
  
  
Insight & Brand Support
  
  
Help with insight mining and attribute mapping.
  
  
Provide data support for brand plans, portfolio analysis and Growth Target Model inputs.
  
  
Research Coordination
  
  
Coordinate with research agencies and data vendors on primary research projects, and follow up on timelines and deliverables.
  
  
Check the quality of the data and outputs received.
  
  
Reporting & Support
  
  
Prepare presentations and reports for reviews.
  
  
Flag deviations from the KPIs, such as sales and market share, for the senior team to act on.
  
  
Support sales and key account teams with market data when needed.
  
  
Key Skills & Competencies
  
  
Functional / Technical
  
  
Market Research & Competitive Intelligence (foundational)
  
  
Data Analysis & MIS Reporting (Excel, PowerPoint)
  
  
Understanding of Pharma / Consumer Healthcare Markets
  
  
Basic Product & Brand Management
  
  
Behavioural
  
  
Analytical Thinking
  
  
Attention to Detail
  
  
Customer Focus
  
  
Learning Agility
  
  
Collaboration & Teamwork

title: Senior Executive
description:
**Role**
The MIS & Finance Analytics role is responsible for delivering timely, accurate, and insight-driven
  
  
financial reports to support business decision-making. The role focuses on transforming data into
  
  
meaningful analysis, enabling performance tracking, forecasting, and strategic planning.
  
  
Working closely with business and finance teams, the role ensures strong data governance, dash
  
  
boarding, and actionable insights to drive operational and financial efficiency.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* MIS Reporting & Dashboards

 Prepare and publish daily, weekly, and monthly MIS reports for business performance tracking
  
  
 Develop dashboards covering sales, margins, costs and key KPIs
  
  
 Automate MIS reporting to improve efficiency and reduce manual dependency
  
  

* Business Performance Analysis

 Analyze financial and operational data to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities
  
  
 Provide insights on revenue, cost, and profitability drivers
  
  
 Support business teams with actionable recommendations
  
  

* Budgeting & Forecasting Support

 Assist in preparation of budgets and rolling forecasts
  
  
 Track actual performance vs budget and highlight key variances
  
  
 Support scenario analysis and business projections
  
  

* Data Management & Governance

 Ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity of financial and business data
  
  
 Maintain master data for reporting systems (sales, pricing, cost, etc.)
  
  
 Work with IT/ERP teams to improve data systems and reporting structures
  
  

* Automation & Digital Initiatives

 Drive automation of reports using Excel, BI tools (Power BI/Tableau), or ERP systems
  
  
 Improve reporting turnaround time and quality of insights
  
  
 Implement standardized templates and reporting frameworks
  
  

* Cross-Functional Business Support

**Job Description**
 Partner with Sales, Supply Chain, HR, and Operations teams for data requirements
  
  
 Provide analytical support for business initiatives and projects
  
  
 Act as a bridge between finance and business teams for data-driven decisions
  
  

* Ad-hoc Analysis & Decision Support

 Conduct ad-hoc analysis for management on business performance, cost trends, and investments
  
  
 Support leadership with presentations, reports, and financial models
  
  
 Provide insights for strategic initiatives and expansion plans

 Track key metrics like receivables, inventory, and payables
  
  
 Monitor KPIs and highlight deviations with root cause analysis
  
  
 Support initiatives to improve cash flow and efficiency

MBA (Finance) / CA/CMA / B.Com with strong analytics exposure
  
  
**Experience**
2 - 6 years of experience in MIS, financial planning & analysis (FP&A), or business analytics roles

title: Product Executive
description:
Role Objective / Major Purpose of the Job
  
  
**Role Objective**
To support the Product Management and Marketing team in planning, executing, and monitoring marketing activities, ensuring effective brand promotion, field support, and implementation of strategic initiatives.
  
  
Principal Tasks & Responsibilities
  
  

* Role Objective:

To manage and deliver accurate MIS reporting, sales analytics, and operational coordination to support Sales & Marketing functions. The role ensures timely reporting, effective data analysis, and coordination with internal teams to support business decisions and improve operational efficiency.
  
  
Principal Tasks & Responsibilities
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Marketing Execution & Support

Develop marketing collaterals, visual aids, and promotional materials as per brand requirements.
  
  
Prepare presentations and communication materials for field force and internal stakeholders.
  
  
Assist in creative campaign design and ensure proper implementation to strengthen brand image.
  
  
Support product management in day-to-day activities, including data collation and reporting.
  
  

* Sales Force & Field Support

Provide training to sales teams on promotional strategies, USPs, and brand campaigns.
  
  
Travel to field locations to oversee implementation of marketing programs and promotional activities.
  
  
Facilitate KOL doctor visits, symposia, and CME programs, ensuring smooth coordination.
  
  

* Financial & Performance Monitoring

Prepare quarterly Profit & Loss statements to track and control budgeted costs per brand plan.
  
  
Monitor marketing performance against set targets internally and externally.
  
  
Ensure stock availability of promotional materials and samples at distribution centers.
  
  

* Data & Analysis

Conduct market research and competitor analysis to support brand strategy.
  
  
Collect, analyze, and report marketing data to guide product planning and strategy decisions.
  
  

* Cross-Functional Coordination

Liaise with Sales, Medical, Regulatory, Supply Chain, and Finance teams to ensure smooth execution of marketing initiatives.
  
  
Support coordination of CRM activities and key customer development initiatives.
  
  
Key Skills & Competencies
  
  
Strong product and therapeutic knowledge
  
  
Understanding of pharma marketing strategies and campaign execution
  
  
Market research and competitor intelligence
  
  
Data analysis and reporting skills
  
  
Cross-functional collaboration
  
  
Knowledge of pharmaceutical compliance and ethical guidelines
  
  

* MIS & Reporting

Prepare daily, mid-month, 28th day, and monthly MIS reports for management and HOD.
  
  
Generate stock availability reports against pending orders and coordinate with the field force.
  
  
Prepare Primary and Secondary Sales reports and share with HO and field teams.
  
  
Prepare CNS-wise and month-wise sales forecasts.
  
  
Maintain and update sales, stock, and performance dashboards.
  
  

* Sales Operations Support

Prepare HO order requests and coordinate with Finance, Marketing, and Distribution teams.
  
  
Track product shortages and follow up with the distribution department.
  
  
Prepare Inter-Branch Transfer (IBT) reports for stock movement.
  
  

* Field Coordination

Coordinate with field staff for new stockist appointments and doctor appointments.
  
  
Communicate with the field team regarding stock updates, sales performance, and targets.
  
  
Respond to field queries and ensure timely resolution.
  
  

* Financial & Administrative Support

Support the annual budget preparation process.
  
  
Monitor stockist credit limits and coordinate with relevant departments for revisions.
  
  
Track overdue outstanding payments and coordinate with field teams for collections.
  
  
Manage concurrence and documentation for payments including field activities, HO executive expenses, and tour claims.
  
  

* Incentive & Performance Data

Prepare incentive raw data and share with the SFE department for further processing.
  
  
Track weekly and monthly target achievements and report performance updates.
  
  

* Process Improvement

Ensure adherence to SOPs and internal processes.
  
  
Simplify reporting systems and improve MIS efficiency.
  
  
Provide accurate reports, analysis, and presentations to management and internal stakeholders.
  
  
Key Skills & Competencies
  
  
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  
  
Advanced proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and data reporting tools
  
  
Knowledge of CRM / ERP systems (SAP, Salesforce, etc.)
  
  
Ability to manage large datasets and generate insights
  
  
High attention to detail and accuracy
  
  
Effective communication and coordination skills
  
  
Understanding of pharmaceutical sales operations and reporting

title: PQC Research Trainee
description:
About the role
  
AllSecureX builds a production post-quantum cryptographic engine, a cryptography-discovery / CBOM platform and quantum-safe hardware, aligned to the National Quantum Mission. As a PQC Research Trainee you will work at the frontier of quantum-safe security, turning standards and papers into real, tested code. PhD scholars, Master's students and those actively working in the domain are welcome (2 positions).
  
  
Responsibilities
  
Study and implement NIST PQC standards — ML-KEM (FIPS 203), ML-DSA (FIPS 204), SLH-DSA (FIPS 205) — and hybrid schemes.
  
Prototype, test and benchmark cryptographic primitives and protocols.
  
Contribute to our core crypto engine, cryptography-discovery tooling and migration research.
  
Read and translate NIST and regulator publications into implementation and test plans.
  
Support security, conformance and tamper testing.
  
What we're looking for
  
Strong grounding in cryptography and/or quantum security — PhD, Master's, or active research in post-quantum, lattice-based, or applied cryptography.
  
Comfort with at least one of C, C++, Rust, Python or Java.
  
Rigour, curiosity and a genuine research mindset.
  
Nice to have
  
Publications, CTF or crypto-competition experience.
  
Familiarity with OpenSSL, BouncyCastle, RustCrypto or PQC reference implementations.
  
Basics of quantum computing and the quantum threat model.

title: Manager - Process Excellence & Cost Optimization
description:
**Job Purpose**
This role controls plant cost and material loss and improves workforce productivity. It does this through standard measurement systems (BOM, cost per sq ft, manpower matrices) and shop-floor automation such as production scanning, smart scheduling and live dashboards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Cost and Financial Control**

* Track monthly plant cost per sq ft against budget, and analyse and explain variances.
* Reconcile BB and COV material consumption and wastage against BOM, keeping variance within 1%.
* Build and maintain a BOM-based tracking system for general consumables, with cost variance within 5%.
* Reconcile and approve job-worker bills within the agreed billing cycle, with no delays.

**Automation and Digital Tracking**

* Implement operator-wise and team-wise production scanning (barcode for COV, QR code for BB) to measure throughput and reduce manpower cost by 10% YoY.
* Drive smart production scheduling and order-kit allocation to improve direct-worker efficiency by 20%.
* Develop an AI / Power BI tracker for media-wise material inflow versus wastage, with full traceability and variance under 1%.
* Maintain daily plant and department dashboards comparing budget and actual cost trends.

**Waste Management and Manpower Productivity**

* Develop at least two alternate or backup buyers for each saleable scrap item or category, targeting a 15% impact on sale value.
* Optimise waste disposal, including balers for cardboard, plastic and fabric, to cut waste volume by 30%.
* Build a manpower performance measurement matrix for non-sq-ft production and non-production departments.
* Support the skill matrix and skill-based operator allocation, and train supervisors and operators in method and productivity improvement (10 people per department).

**General Duties**

* Conduct time and motion studies, set standard times, and balance lines.
* Prepare monthly MIS and variance reports for management.
* Coordinate with production, stores, finance, IT and vendors.
* Lead Lean, Kaizen and 5S initiatives.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech in Industrial, Mechanical or Production Engineering. An MBA or PGDIE is preferred.
* 8–12 years in manufacturing industrial engineering, costing or productivity, including at least 3 years leading projects or a team.

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong in BOM and inventory reconciliation, cost analysis, time study and production scheduling.
* Skilled in advanced Excel and Power BI, with exposure to ERP/MES and barcode or QR systems. AI or analytics knowledge is a plus.
* Analytical, detail-oriented and comfortable presenting data to senior management.
* Able to work across departments and train shop-floor teams.
